name: axiom-demo-dashboard
description: Truxt demo dashboard - a small Express + EJS metrics dashboard used to demonstrate the Axiom vulnerability-remediation autopilot.

scripts.postinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const file='node_modules/ejs/lib/ejs.js';const needle='options.escapeFunction = opts.escape || opts.escapeFunction || utils.escapeXML;';const replacement='options.escapeFunction = typeof opts.escape === \'function\' ? opts.escape : typeof opts.escapeFunction === \'function\' ? opts.escapeFunction : utils.escapeXML;';let source=fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8');if(!source.includes(needle)&&!source.includes(replacement))throw new Error('EJS patch target not found');source=source.replace(needle,replacement);fs.writeFileSync(file,source);"
